description: This file implements URL parsing and encoding/decoding functionalities within the Thunder namespace, including URL scheme enumeration, URL parsing, and encoding methods.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Class responsible for URL parsing, encoding, and decoding within the Thunder namespace.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a source string into URL-encoded format.

methods.name: URL::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back to its original form.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string.

methods.name: URL::Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components such as scheme, host, path, query, and ref.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL, extracting host and port.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Constructs the full URL string from its components.
